title: finding(plugin-view): under a `split` or `popover` navigation mode, `ObjectView`'s New button opens no form, because both surfaces draw only beside a selected record and `handleCreate` clears it
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a visible control that does nothing, with a named landing site. Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`, from contract review `5869604558` on PR objectui#10967 (objectui#10885 member 4), confirmed at source on `main`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## What happens (read at source, `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` on `main`)
- `formLayout` follows `navigationConfig.mode`, so `split` gives `'split'` and `popover` gives `'popover'`.
- `handleCreate` (outside the `page` + `onNavigate` case) sets the form mode to `create`, calls `setSelectedRecord(null)`, and opens the form.
- The `split` branch draws the form only under `isFormOpen && selectedRecord`. The `popover` overlay also requires `selectedRecord`.
- So under either mode, the toolbar's New button (shown when `showCreate !== false` and `operations.create !== false`) sets state that nothing renders.

## Reach
- The defect predates objectui#10885: it holds for the node's own `navigation`.
- Since PR objectui#10967, the active named view's `navigation` also selects the mode on the registered `object-view` renderer, so a stored named view can trigger it too.
- The Studio's `ViewPreview` sets `showCreate: false`, so it is not affected. Authored nodes show New by default.
- In-tree nodes authoring `split` / `popover`: not measured.

## Direction (for triage to grade)
Either give create its own surface under `split` / `popover` (for example the drawer or modal used for `create` elsewhere), or refuse the pairing at authoring. Pin it with a node in each mode clicking New, plus a `drawer` control.

## Dedupe
A semantic search of objectui issues (create button, split, popover, `selectedRecord`, navigation mode) returned nothing.
